exact: hemopoietic stem cell migration to bone marrow

definition: The orderly movement of a hematopoietic stem cell into the bone marrow, and its subsequent positioning within defined functional compartments in that microenvironment. A hematopoietic stem cell is a cell from which all cells of the lymphoid and myeloid lineages develop, including blood cells and cells of the immune system.
label: hematopoietic stem cell migration to bone marrow
